channel.title: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) - Official News & Updates
channel.description: Official RSS feed of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) & Cockroach Janta Party Wale. Founded by Abhijeet Dipke. Youth movement, NEET paper leak audit, and student reforms.

item.title: 6 August 2026: CJP Jharkhand Update — Indefinite Hunger Strike Escalates at Jaipal Singh Munda Stadium as Assembly Opens
item.description: As the Jharkhand State Assembly Monsoon Session opens on 6 August, 6 student leaders fast at Jaipal Singh Munda Stadium. CJP & Founder Abhijeet Dipke demand independent CBI exam leak audit, 100% Meritocracy, and open media-covered talks with CM.

item.title: 5 August 2026: CJP Jharkhand Chapter Launches Mega Youth Protest Across Ranchi & Jamshedpur
item.description: CJP Jharkhand chapter and Founder Abhijeet Dipke launch massive youth rallies across Ranchi, Jamshedpur, and Dhanbad demanding independent 3rd-party exam server log audits, 100% Meritocracy, and student rights.

item.title: 4 August 2026: CJP Releases Official National Reform Poster & Comprehensive News Update
item.description: CJP Founder Abhijeet Dipke releases official 4 August National Reform Poster covering 100% Meritocracy advocacy, zero electoral ambitions, Supreme Court FIR drop verification, and active Assam flood relief.

item.title: 4 August 2026: CJP Legal Cell Submits Supreme Court Compliance Report on Student FIR Withdrawals
item.description: Legal delegates of Cockroach Janta Party file compliance monitoring report in Apex Court, confirming state police departments have begun expunging cases filed against student protesters.

item.title: 3 August 2026: SC Clarification on Student FIRs a 'Big Victory' for Youth, Says CJP; Seeks Immediate Withdrawal
item.description: Supreme Court bench grants major relief to CJP student protesters, directing Delhi and state police to immediately drop all protest FIRs without procedural delays.

item.title: 3 August 2026: My U.S. Studies Funded by Scholarship & Education Loan: CJP Founder Abhijeet Dipke Responds to RTI Query
item.description: Addressing viral RTI inquiries, CJP Founder Abhijeet Dipke releases official financial disclosures proving his U.S. higher education was 100% funded through merit scholarships and bank loans.

item.title: 3 August 2026: Probe PM CARES Fund, Modi Ji Will Forgive You: CJP Takes Swipe at RTI Activist & Demands Degree Disclosure
item.description: CJP spokesperson takes a sharp satirical swipe at partisan RTI activists: 'Will the emperor show his degree?' while urging investigators to audit PM CARES fund allocations.

item.title: 3 August 2026: CJP Clarifies Protest Footage Reaffirming Zero Electoral Ambitions; CBI Fast-Track Hearing Begins
item.description: CJP Founder Abhijeet Dipke clarifies old protest clips, reaffirming zero electoral ambitions and focus on student advocacy. Special fast-track court conducts key hearing on CBI NTA paper leak chargesheet.

item.title: 2 August 2026: CJP Demands ₹1 Crore Compensation for NEET Aspirant Families; Warns of Fresh Sit-in Protests
item.description: CJP issues formal ultimatum demanding ₹1 Crore financial compensation for families of NEET-UG candidates lost to suicide, warning of new sit-in rallies across state capitals if unaddressed.

item.title: 1 August 2026: CJP Expands Grassroots Network to 300+ Coordinators; SC Orders Release of Student Protesters
item.description: CJP consolidates volunteer network across 28 states; Shiv Sena (UBT) Chief Uddhav Thackeray invites Abhijeet Dipke to Matoshree; Supreme Court orders immediate release of student activists.

item.title: 31 July 2026 Historic Victory Gazette: Union Cabinet Passes 100% Meritocracy Act & Drops Student FIRs
item.description: Union Cabinet officially gazettes the Meritocracy & Exam Integrity Act 2026! All pending FIRs against student activists across 28 states unconditionally quashed as CJP youth swarm passes 30 Million registered members.

item.title: CJP Reservation Hatao Andolan & Supreme Court Notice 28 July 2026: 100% Meritocracy Movement
item.description: Supreme Court bench hears CJP's urgent PIL demanding 100% Merit-Based entrance examinations and financial scholarships based on economic need instead of caste quotas.
